coverage.observation: Wave evidence is distinguished from vibration direction. Young/Fresnel and ether/inertia account are retained as source history, not a current mechanical model of light.

Green tourmaline, uniaxial cut, normal incidence and both experiments agree across locales. Plate-surface parallelism is distinguished from aligned/crossed crystal axes. The longitudinal-model limitation is explained without introducing an opaque barrier.

Transverse electric-field vibration and natural/unpolarized light without a preferred transverse direction are explained. The language describes distributed directions, not one field vector simultaneously pointing every way. Water motion is explicitly a simplified source comparison.

Plane p, transverse direction, polarizer/analyzer, 90-degree idealized extinction and amplitude projection are preserved. No unsupported intensity-projection formula or wavelength conversion is introduced.

Rubber rope, first narrow wooden box and crossed second box retain the source model. Real rope displacement is separated from light electric-field variation; blocked transmitted motion is not all energy or all rope motion disappearing.

Iodoquinine sulfate, celluloid/glass, 0.1 mm and large-area advantage are retained as historical material details. Violet-to-white remains an attributed claim with a correct warning against generalizing polarization as spectral conversion. The 45-degree headlights/windshield proposal, opposing-light rejection, own-road-reflection expectation and all-cars condition remain historical, not guaranteed safe vehicle guidance.
All five original figure markers and caption references are retained in order with locale labels. This does not approve diagram pixels or modern geometry.
